purity_scope: All supported shipped A2FO executable implementations; OS/closed game services external; build/test orchestration and historical references excluded from runtime.
method_limits: The stage16 receipt is a historical candidate; current Makefile and files may have changed.
Third-party MMM source mapping follows Makefile object rules; source existence is recorded per row.
MinGW CRT/archive member source origin and exact extracted archive members are not established by the link receipt.

The standalone target prerequisite inventory is expanded from Makefile but is not a link receipt; actual per-target linked objects, archive member extraction, and optional target reachability were not independently established.
Quoted-include scanning is a discovery aid; macros, conditions, executable headers and optional targets require P00/P17 closure.
46 family owners are pending audit; file presence does not establish complete behavior understanding.
